title: Goldmaker Labs
caption:
This company turns lead into gold. For real.

GoldMaker Labs runs industrial alchemy: lead in, gold out. It sells gold bars, supplies ultra-pure gold to chipmakers, and licenses 'made gold' jewellery.

Its edge is a secret process nobody has cracked. The risks: make too much and the gold price falls, energy costs are huge, and fellow alchemists RuneWorks have recipes of their own.

Find GoldMaker Labs at memestreet.net

narration: This company turns lead into gold. For real. Meet GoldMaker Labs, from the alchemy industry on Meme Street's fictional market. Lead goes into its furnaces, and gold comes out. Real alchemy, at industrial scale. It sells gold bars, supplies ultra pure gold to chipmakers, and licenses made gold jewellery collections. Cheaper gold helps electronics, jewellery, and even dentistry. Gold, where it's needed, at a lower cost. Its edge is a secret process that nobody else has managed to crack. The risks? Make too much, and the gold price falls. Energy costs are huge, and fellow alchemists RuneWorks are working on their own recipes. On Meme Street, stories like these hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Find GoldMaker Labs, at memestreet.net.
